skill.name: taiwan-garbage
skill.description: 查台北市、新北市與台中市的垃圾車清運點、路線與停靠時間。垃圾車、倒垃圾、垃圾時間、清運點、資源回收車、幾點來、今天有沒有收垃圾的問題適用。免登入，台北用臺北市資料大平臺 CSV，新北用新北市資料開放平臺 JSON，台中用台中市政府資料開放平臺（經 data.gov.tw 資源下載）。其他縣市尚未支援；是計畫停靠時間，不是即時 GPS。
skill.summary: Find scheduled garbage and recycling collection stops in Taipei, New Taipei, and Taichung using public government datasets.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: Most findings are Markdown formatting, public government URLs, dataset identifiers, and legitimate data processing rather than malicious execution or reconnaissance. Seven temporary-file writes use predictable paths, creating local overwrite and symlink risks in shared environments. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Downloads and transformations write to predictable temporary paths.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private directory with mktemp -d, store all downloaded and transformed files there, and clean it up after use.

content.user_title: Find Taiwan Garbage Collection Stops and Times
content.value_statement: Collection schedules use different datasets and formats across Taipei, New Taipei, and Taichung. This skill guides your assistant through public-data downloads and local filtering to find scheduled stops and recycling availability.
actual_capabilities: Guide downloads of public collection datasets for Taipei, New Taipei, and Taichung without login or API keys.
Filter collection records by district, neighborhood, scheduled time, and available address descriptions.
Select the next scheduled stop using local Asia/Taipei time.
Check weekday garbage and recycling availability using New Taipei and Taichung dataset fields.
Rank nearby Taipei and New Taipei stops using approximate coordinate differences.
Explain pagination, UTF-8 BOM removal, changed resource links, and API error responses.
limitations: Only Taipei, New Taipei, and Taichung are covered; other Taiwan cities are not supported.
Schedules are planned times, not live GPS or guaranteed arrivals; holidays and weather disruptions require official announcements.
Taichung records lack coordinates and update-date fields, so coordinate-based nearest-stop ranking and freshness verification are unavailable.
Downloads require network access and shell tools; examples use predictable temporary filenames that should be replaced with private storage.

use_cases.title: Find an evening collection stop
use_cases.description: Check scheduled collection points in a Taipei neighborhood after work and compare arrival times.

use_cases.title: Check neighborhood recycling days
use_cases.description: Compare New Taipei garbage and recycling weekday flags before sharing a collection schedule.

use_cases.title: Plan disposal around opening hours
use_cases.description: Look up Taichung collection addresses and weekday time windows near a shop.

prompt_templates.title: Find neighborhood stops
prompt_templates.prompt: Find scheduled garbage collection stops in [Taipei district] and [neighborhood]. Show location, arrival time, departure time, and route.

prompt_templates.title: Check collection today
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether [New Taipei district] and [neighborhood] have garbage and recycling collection today. Use Asia/Taipei time and distinguish schedules from service disruptions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare nearby evening stops
prompt_templates.prompt: Find five nearby scheduled stops in New Taipei around [latitude, longitude] after [time] today. Apply weekday flags and label coordinate ranking as approximate.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine location, weekday, and time filters

prompt_templates.title: Compare weekly collection windows
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare garbage and recycling windows for [Taichung district] and [neighborhood] across the week. Use private temporary storage and report missing fields or download failures.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: a complete weekly report with explicit data boundaries

output_examples.input: Show the report format for a Taipei stop lookup without making a live request.
output: Illustrative format only; no collection record has been retrieved.
District and neighborhood: values from the selected dataset record.
Collection location: the recorded stop description.
Arrival and departure: scheduled times converted from HHMM.
Route and trip: identifiers from the same record.
Timing note: planned schedule, not live vehicle tracking.

output_examples.input: Find garbage collection times in Kaohsiung.
output_examples.output: Kaohsiung is not supported by this skill. Coverage includes Taipei, New Taipei, and Taichung. Consult the Kaohsiung government open-data platform.

output_examples.input: Find the nearest Taichung collection stop using my coordinates.
output_examples.output: The Taichung dataset contains address descriptions but no coordinates. Provide a district, neighborhood, or road name to filter collection points.

best_practices: Provide the city, district, and exact Traditional Chinese neighborhood name before requesting a lookup.
Use Asia/Taipei time and check collection flags separately for garbage and recycling.
Download into private temporary storage, verify data formats and pagination, and confirm disruption notices with the city environmental authority.
anti_patterns: Treating a scheduled arrival as a live GPS estimate or a guaranteed collection time.
Assuming the first New Taipei API page includes every stop or applying Taipei field names to other cities.
Guessing unmatched neighborhoods, inventing missing times, or ranking Taichung stops by unavailable coordinates.

faq.question: Which cities are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers Taipei City, New Taipei City, and Taichung City. Other cities are not supported.

faq.question: Do I need an account or API key?
faq.answer: The documented government datasets are publicly downloadable without login or API keys. Network access and local command tools are required.

faq.question: Does the skill track trucks in real time?
faq.answer: No. It uses planned collection schedules, not live GPS. Traffic, holidays, and severe weather can change actual service.

faq.question: Can it check recycling collection today?
faq.answer: New Taipei and Taichung provide weekday recycling fields. Check them separately from garbage fields and confirm exceptional changes through official notices.

faq.question: Can it find the closest stop?
faq.answer: Taipei and New Taipei provide coordinates for approximate ranking. Taichung supports district, neighborhood, and address filtering but lacks coordinates.

faq.question: What happens when a download fails?
faq.answer: The skill describes refreshing changed resource links, checking error responses, and reporting unavailable data. It should not invent missing collection records.
